🚨🇲🇽 <u>SHEINBAUM ANSWERS TRUMP'S UN "EPICENTER" LINE</u>

At the UN General Assembly, Trump called Mexico the "epicenter" of cartel violence and claimed criminal groups control its territory. Sheinbaum said Mexico won't accept being blamed unilaterally for drug trafficking, then added: "I could also say it's hard to live next to a country with such high drug consumption, or with so much weapons production, but I won't say it because we have a good relationship."
banner: SHEINBAUM TO TRUMP: YOUR DRUGS, YOUR GUNS

text:
🇲🇽🏭 <u>DATA CENTERS DRINK QUERÉTARO'S WATER DURING A DROUGHT</u>

Oxfam Mexico warns that data centers are spreading faster than tax and environmental rules can keep up. In Querétaro, where more than 90% of the state was in drought in 2024 and 2025, a single data center holds permits to pump up to 25 million liters from wells, while communities in Colón and El Marqués suffer water and power cuts. Oxfam calls it a new dependency between central and peripheral countries, this time digital.
banner: DATA CENTERS: 25M LITERS IN A DROUGHT

🚨🇲🇽 <u>HURRICANE POLO: NAVY DEPLOYS 2,923 TO BAJA CALIFORNIA SUR</u>

With Category 3 Hurricane Polo bearing down on Baja California Sur, the Mexican Navy has 2,923 emergency brigade members on the ground, 589 of them at the Santa Rosalía naval sector. The ship Isla Tiburón sailed for Mazatlán carrying an MI-17 helicopter, 2,000 food packages, 8,000 liters of drinking water and heavy machinery. 111 shelters are open in La Paz, Los Cabos, Comondú, Loreto and Mulegé, with room for 14,445 people.
📸 Honestidad y resultados — Zócalo, Ciudad de México, 27 de septiembre de 2026
📸 Honestidad y resultados — Zócalo, Ciudad de México, 27 de septiembre de 2026

🇲🇽🌎 "Mexico is nobody's backyard. Mexico extends its hand, but never bows its head." — Clara Brugada, Head of Government of Mexico City, Zócalo "Today, when the shadows of imperialist ambition spread again, let us back the President and build national unity." Welcoming Sheinbaum to the Zócalo, the Mexico City mayor called for three unities: of the people, of the Transformation movement, and of the nation. "In a world where winds of hatred blow and war drums sound again, where the far right advances and even fascism resurges, our President's leadership is an international democratic reference."

🇲🇽✊ Mexico City: 70.26 billion pesos in well-being programs for 3 million people in 2026. — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, Honesty and Results, Zócalo, Mexico City 1,377,198 older adults receive their pension, along with 255,000 people with disabilities and 321,684 women aged 60 to 64. Public-school scholarships reach 389,305 high school, 312,885 secondary and 387,867 primary students, and 935,462 children receive low-cost milk. Another ~60 billion pesos go to works: IMSS Hospital 25 in Iztapalapa, a women's cancer hospital, 804 IMSS-Bienestar clinics, Metro Line 12 to Observatorio and Cablebús Line 4. The Zócalo closed a 12-day tour of all 31 states, with some 850,000 attendees.

🇲🇽⚖️ "They stopped being commodities, stopped being privileges, and once again became rights of the people of Mexico." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, Honesty and Results, Zócalo, Mexico City In two years, the Constitution recognized education at all levels, student scholarships, health and housing as rights. The universal pension for older adults and the disability pension became constitutional, the 40-hour work week was approved, and the minimum wage must always rise above inflation. Indigenous and Afro-Mexican peoples are now subjects of public law, and from 2030 no elected office allows re-election.

🔥🇲🇽 "They never understood that this people carries in its DNA the dignity of Hidalgo, the firmness of Morelos, the patriotism of Juárez." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, Honesty and Results, Zócalo, Mexico City "During the neoliberal period, they wanted to make us believe that the country's decisions had to be made in luxury offices, behind the people's backs, handing the nation's assets to a few, dismantling social rights and opening the door to foreign interference. But they were wrong." She traced the people's answer to each betrayal: Ayutla against Santa Anna, Juárez against Maximilian, the Revolution against Porfirio Díaz, and the Fourth Transformation after "36 years of betrayals by neoliberal governments."

🇲🇽🌎 "Sovereignty means that only the people determine the destiny of Mexico." "Since 1814, no foreign power, no economic or political elite has the right to dictate the present and the future of our homeland." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, Honesty and Results, Zócalo, Mexico City She closed her 12-day accountability tour of the country in the Zócalo on September 27, the 205th anniversary of the consummation of Independence. Unlike other Latin American independences led by criollo military men, she said, Mexico's began as a mass popular movement that called for abolishing slavery. "We Mexicans do not want interference, nor interventionism, nor violation of our territoriality."
